notes.zh-CN: 新增第三方提供商模型列表搜索：编辑提供商时，模型列表顶部新增搜索框，可按模型 ID 快速过滤勾选，中英文界面均支持。macOS 为 universal，开发签名未公证；Windows 安装包未签名；APK 为 debug 签名；IPA 为开发签名，仅限团队已注册设备。
notes.en: Add a filter box to the model list in the provider editor: type to narrow models by ID before ticking them. UI text is localized in both English and Simplified Chinese. macOS is universal and development-signed, not notarized; Windows installers are unsigned; APK is debug-signed; IPA is development-signed for registered team devices.
